accepted.question_text: Extend the results on measure rigidity of unipotent flows to the adelic setting. It seems natural to expect (and is known in some cases) that th e set of finite ergodic invariant measures for other dynamical systems with parabolic behavior has a manageable structure, which is possible to describe in algebraic terms. Suppose that H is a connected semisimple Lie subgroup of a Lie group G, and let P be a parabolic subgroup of H. One of manifestations of the measure rigidity of unipotent flows is the fact that every finite P -invariant measure on G/Γ is H invariant (see [193]).
